method: getBoundingClientRect() centre of each element, read from the live page through the console's CDP route with harness/probe_page.py at a 1280x600 viewport, so CSS pixels and image pixels are the same number. The four delete buttons differ only in x: 136, 436, 736, 1036 at y 165.

measured.note: The page gives every button an aria-label carrying the sandbox id (aria-label="delete browser-pool-65l7z"), which is what makes the accessibility tree able to tell the four look-alike delete buttons apart. Without those labels the AX names are all "delete" and the DOM arm has nothing to disambiguate with; that was the first attempt's failure.

t-tg-export-csv.absent_reason: The page's controls are '+ claim', '+ bare sandbox', 'fill demo grid', 'teardown', 'capacity', and per card 'probe' and 'delete'. Nothing exports CSV.
